results.name: Breaking Bad
results.overview: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.

results.name: Breaking Bad Fortune Teller
results.overview: During the Ming Dynasty, the emperor sets out for Xinjiang to advocate peace. Shortly after his absence, mysterious occurrences plague the palace and Daoist Tian Mu Tong is called to cast out demons. Together with eunuch Xiao Mo Gu and Jin Yi Wei leader Yun Xiang Rong, Mu Tong uncovers deep dark secrets and conspiracies hidden within conspiracies.

results.name: The Bad Guys: Breaking In
results.overview: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

results.title: Daniel Brühl: Breaking Bad
results.original_title: Daniel Brühl – Der Reiz des Bösen
results.overview: A portrait of the Spanish-German actor Daniel Brühl, a versatile performer capable of moving easily from the gentlest to the darkest role.

results.title: ISMO – Breaking Bad English
results.overview: ISMO – Breaking Bad English is a cinematic version of the saying “through hardships to the stars.” Ismo, who grew up in Jyväskylä, is a shy boy with a vivid imagination who has trouble fitting in. As a student in his twenties, he stumbles upon a new form of expression in Finland, stand-up comedy, which suits him perfectly. Ismo quickly rises to become one of Finland’s most successful stand-up comedians, but that’s not enough for him. He decides to pursue a career in the United States, the homeland of the world’s most famous comedians.

results.title: El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
results.original_title: El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
results.overview: In the wake of his dramatic escape from captivity, Jesse Pinkman must come to terms with his past in order to forge some kind of future.

results.name: Breaking Bad: Original Minisodes
results.overview: Breaking Bad: Original Minisodes is a web series based on the television series Breaking Bad. A total of 17 "minisodes", which are more comedy-oriented than most full episodes, were released over the course of three years.

results.title: Snow Globe: A Breaking Bad Short
results.original_title: Snow Globe: A Breaking Bad Short
results.overview: Todd finds the courage to reach out to his Breaking Bad co-conspirator Lydia with a very important question.

results.title: Breaking in Badly
results.overview: A detective is called in at the dead of night to investigate a series of seemingly unrelated crimes. Slowly, he begins to realise something far more insidious may be afoot.

results.title: The Road to El Camino: Behind the Scenes of El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
results.original_title: The Road to El Camino: Behind the Scenes of El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
results.overview: Aaron Paul, Vince Gilligan and other cast members, producers and crew share stories and footage from the making of "El Camino."

results.title: No Half Measures: Creating the Final Season of Breaking Bad
results.original_title: No Half Measures: Creating the Final Season of Breaking Bad
results.overview: A documentary about the making of season five of the acclaimed AMC series Breaking Bad.

results.title: Breaking Bad Wolf
results.overview: Veteran cop John Mark Dougan left the force, appalled by corruption within. He started a forum for honest cops to anonymously expose police the bad. Fierce backlash eventually forced Dougan to flee the US and seek refuge in Russia.

results.title: The Bad News Bears in Breaking Training
results.original_title: The Bad News Bears in Breaking Training
results.overview: A troubled, rebellious teen drives his rambunctious baseball team out to Houston where they play an exhibition game and the boy meets his estranged father, and hires him as the teams coach.

results.name: Breaking Bad - E01-dj smith
results.overview: Walter White is a brilliant but unfulfilled chemist whose life has become a quiet tragedy of missed opportunities and financial strain. When he is diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer, he fears leaving his family destitute. In a moment of desperate inspiration, he uses his expertise not for good, but for profit. He enlists a small-time ex-student, Jesse Pinkman, as his streetwise partner to build a crystal meth empire. This movie is locally translated by DJ Smith
